summary: Replay transport/export stays inside the browser trust boundary: MediaRecorder → blob download only (no product-API upload), no secrets in the diff, runReplay decode unchanged and client-only, export filenames allow-listed to numeric peak + UTC date + mime extension, keyboard capture reuses isInteractiveTarget, climb/result and leaderboard write paths untouched. Zero critical findings.
goal: Climb replay should allow fast forwarding, rewind, pause/play. Export as mp4.

findings.issue: NFR-6 held: export ends in URL.createObjectURL + <a download>; new modules have zero fetch/XHR/sendBeacon/WebSocket. Video bytes never leave the browser for product APIs.
findings.reproduction: rg fetch|upload|/api/ across useReplayExport, exportMime, ReplayTransportBar, paintClimbFrame, replayTransport, replaySnapshots, cloneMatch — empty. onstop only calls downloadBlob.
findings.fix: None. Keep export path free of network I/O if extended.

findings.issue: Secret scan clean: no api keys, INTERNAL_TOKEN, Stripe secrets, or private key material in the feature diff. No package.json / lockfile changes (no new CVE surface from deps).
findings.fix: None for this feature. Pre-existing next@14.0.4 audit debt remains open in the ledger and is out of scope here.

findings.issue: Share token still decoded only client-side via decodeRunReplay; runReplay encode/decode and MAX_REPLAY_TOKEN_LENGTH unchanged. Export filename is climb-{Math.round(peakY)}m-{yyyyMMdd}.{mp4|webm} — peakY already Number.isFinite-gated at decode; extension from pickExportMime allow-list. No path/HTML injection via download name.
findings.reproduction: Confirm runReplay.ts absent from feature diff; decodeRunReplay rejects non-finite peakY; filename interpolates only number + digit date + extension enum.
findings.fix: None. If filename builder is later exported for tests, keep the same numeric/allow-list composition.

findings.issue: Replay keydown handler mounts only when replaying and gates on shouldCaptureReplayKey(..., isInteractiveTarget). Live shouldCaptureGameKey interactive exemption unchanged. Space/j/k/l/. /Home/0 will not steal focus from buttons, links, inputs, or role=slider (seek bar).
findings.reproduction: Unit: shouldCaptureReplayKey(key,true,true)===false; shouldCaptureReplayKey(key,false,*)===false. Live Space during climb with non-interactive target still true (AC-20).
findings.fix: None. QA should smoke-check mute/Start/Export while focused still receive Space.

findings.issue: Trust boundary #1 (client-submitted climb scores) untouched: no API/db/prisma/middleware diffs. postRun still early-returns when replaying. Free-leaderboard open question remains out of scope per architect exception.
findings.reproduction: git diff main...HEAD --name-only -- 'app/app/api/**' 'app/src/db/**' 'app/prisma/**' empty; ClimbScene finished effect retains `if (!finished || posted || replaying) return`.
findings.fix: None for this feature. Do not mark free-leaderboard trust boundary closed.

findings.issue: Export success/error/aria-live copy rendered as React text children (no innerHTML / dangerouslySetInnerHTML). Canvas HUD uses fillText only. err.message passthrough on blob failure is React-escaped — not an XSS sink.
findings.reproduction: rg innerHTML|dangerouslySetInnerHTML on new UI modules — empty. Error UI is `{exportStatus.message}` text node.
findings.fix: Optional hardening: map encode failures to fixed copy instead of err.message (defense-in-depth; not required to merge).

learnings.insight: Security review of replay transport/export: 0 critical, 0 warning, 6 info. Client-only MediaRecorder download confirmed; climb/result and leaderboard write paths absent from the diff; keyboard interactive exemption preserved.
learnings.action: Proceed to qa-acceptance; do not loopBack to implementer for this stage.

learnings.insight: A client-only export that never calls fetch is a trust-boundary control you can prove by absence: no network APIs in the export module plus a single downloadBlob (createObjectURL → <a download> → revoke). Coupling filename to Math.round(finite peakY) + digit date + mime allow-list removes query-token string injection from the download attribute.
learnings.action: When adding any 'share/export' path, require the same no-network grep and allow-listed filename composition; never interpolate raw ?r= token bytes into DOM attributes or URLs that leave the origin.

learnings.insight: Free-leaderboard trust-boundary open question remains unresolved and correctly out of scope for replay transport/export — implementer did not touch climb/result persistence.
learnings.action: Keep the ledger open question; do not treat this feature's success as closing score authenticity.

appliedLearnings: Did not close free-leaderboard trust boundary (architect exception + standing Security ledger)
Confirmed non-test callers of export/transport exist before treating controls as real
Treated monotonic climb/result write as hard boundary — verified path untouched rather than trusting comments
Verified interactive-target exemption on new key predicate (standing Spec quality rule)

trustBoundaryConclusions.videoBytes: browser-only; never uploaded to product servers
trustBoundaryConclusions.scorePersistence: climb/result + leaderboard write paths unchanged; postRun skipped while replaying
trustBoundaryConclusions.xss: React text + canvas fillText; download filename allow-listed
